# Mentor Language Institute (MLI)

> Affordable English language school in Los Angeles, CA, with campuses in Westwood (near UCLA) and Hollywood. Founded in 2002; accredited by ACCET and authorized by BPPE and SEVP. Offers ESL, test preparation, conversation, and short-term English programs; I-20 and Change of Status support for F-1 student visas; housing assistance and airport transfer; student activities; and UCLA summer, seasonal, and Dance Camps.
